rationale.ai-review: Independent LLM validators score PLC code and undergo reliability calibration.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Compilation, property tests, lexical checks, and fault injection verify outputs.
rationale.risk-routing: BLEU and length thresholds prioritize candidates for deeper LITL/HITL inspection.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Expert PLC engineers provide a structured final safety acceptance gate.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Reasoning summaries and requirements-to-code traceability support expert judgment.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Versioned prompts, decisions, findings, and code differences preserve auditability.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports empirical readability, modularity, correctness, and maintainability results.
